authorization: 2026-11-12 user selected LFP MTAD-GAT and TranAD, stride1 vs5, one epoch each; same initialization, normal validation and fixed test metrics, exploratory only; user subsequently expanded to all four original stride1 models
preprocessing: normal-training-only MinMax; width<1e-12=>1; no clipping; per-snippet NaN/Inf interpolation and nearest endpoint; entirely missing channel=>normal-training valid-observation median
checkpoint_selection: fixed end of epoch1; interim validation diagnostic only
training_window_policy: all retained normal snippets, stride1 or5, append end-aligned full tail window if necessary; no cross-snippet windows; no window cap
aggregation: mean of largest ceil(0.05*n) native scores per snippet, at least1
threshold: normal validation snippet scores P95, numpy linear quantile, predict >= threshold
evaluation_scope: same fixed test cohort; no point adjustment; no test-based stride/checkpoint selection

native_score.omni: author release port negative Gaussian log probability at last window point; batch500 with separate shared-noise groups50
native_score.dc: author temperature50 softmax(-sum forward and reverse KL), all window points; scoring stride105+tail; overlap average then snippet top5%

model_identity.mtad: ML4ITS third-party GATv2/GRU variant, accepted by user
model_identity.tranad: author released implementation, legacy API compatibility shim only
model_identity.omni: author-release project PyTorch port, previously accepted semantics and batch500
model_identity.dc: author DCdetector snapshot, native minimax gradients and score

first_epoch_limitation: TranAD native epoch1 weights are first_loss1 and second_loss0; one-epoch results do not establish final-stage quality or convergence
storage_estimate: Reuse existing~0.31GiB LFP cache; eight checkpoint and score sets estimated<1GiB extra
runtime_estimate: Approximately5-6h including full normal validation at0/50/100%, score validation/test; CPU preparation reused. No automatic reruns on failure.
validation_diagnostic_limits: DC objective is cancelling and not a convergence criterion; report separate prior/series components; Omni uses identical dedicated normal-validation RNG streams for paired comparisons
cache_policy: Training/evaluation read only frozen preprocessed input files, boundaries, metadata and training-only scaler; no original CSV reload or automatic rebuild. Reuse same bundle locally and on Kaggle.
